name: Kisaragi Kurenai
source: The "living doll" of the Kisaragi Family, handed down in it through past generations. In the story, she appears on the night when the ceremony is being held, and deludes Seiichi with her words. It is not known whether she poses a danger to people, what with the mysteries surrounding her. Always calm and collected. Is it Rei's second personality, or is it...
